text: 因油价上涨和美国国债收益率走高，金价周二下跌，因前两者提高了持有无收益黄金的机会成本。不过，金价本月迄今仍上涨超过10%。三菱日联金融集团分析师表示“尽管如此，投资者需求回升以及各国央行增持黄金，仍为金价提供了支撑。展望未来，美联储7月会议纪要以及美联储主席沃什在杰克逊霍尔会议上的讲话，将成为判断利率前景的关键。”
text_en: Gold prices fell on Tuesday due to rising oil prices and higher U.S. Treasury yields, as both raised the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding gold. However, gold is still up more than 10% so far this month. Analysts at Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group said, "Nonetheless, recovering investor demand and central bank gold purchases continue to support gold prices. Looking ahead, the Fed's July meeting minutes and comments from Fed Chair Warsh at the Jackson Hole conference will be key to judging the interest rate outlook."
